recipes.name: Vegan Chocolate Buttercream Frosting
ingredients: ⅓ cup melted dairy-free dark chocolate
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the butter and use an electric hand mixer to beat the butter until soft and fluffy.
Then add the powdered sugar, cocoa powder, milk, and vanilla. Mix at a low speed and gradually increase until everything is well combined.
Add the melted chocolate and mix again. The frosting is now ready to use on cakes and cupcakes!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter.

Storage The frosting can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. When using the frosting again, make sure to bring it to room temperature again to soften and mix it through before using.
